$comment: The golden corpus of the conversion between the app's models and the engine's definition, of the app's reading of a saved model and its input hash (crates/cslope-project, tests/golden.rs), made by the app's code with packages/desktop/scripts/project-corpus.ts; do not edit. Verification entries are digests (FNV-1a 64 over the JSON value, see the script) of the model Help › Benchmarks opens and its definition; their problems are in golden/verification.json.
